'''Josef Thelcar''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and the brother of [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Erim Thelcar]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Although Josef Thelcar was the brother of a Zabrak, examining his remains revealed his [[Bone/Legends|bones]] to be those of "a Human [[Skeleton/Legends|skeleton]]."
